# Yesp — UK Operational Excellence, Digital Transformation & AI Transformation

> Yesp is a UK management consultancy that helps mid-market businesses (50–500 employees) transform operations. Yesp diagnoses operational problems first, then builds the systems that fix them — including a working prototype delivered as part of the fixed-fee assessment. Yesp is the UK practice of Yesp Studio, a global technology partner founded in Tamil Nadu, India, operating across India, UK, US, and Germany.

## What Yesp Does

Yesp delivers three connected services for UK mid-market businesses:

1. **Operational Excellence** — Process mapping, KPI frameworks, bottleneck elimination, and reporting system builds. You leave with a working prototype, not a slide deck.
2. **Digital Transformation** — System integration, workflow automation, data platform build, and real-time BI. Connects disconnected systems and ends spreadsheet chaos.
3. **AI Transformation** — AI readiness assessment, use case prioritisation, pilot development, and deployment tied to agreed ROI metrics.

## How Yesp Engages

Every engagement starts with a fixed-fee Transformation Assessment:

- **Duration:** 2–3 weeks
- **Deliverables:** 6 — Current State Assessment, Opportunity Register, ROI Analysis, 90-Day Roadmap, Executive Presentation, Working Prototype
- **Key differentiator:** The Working Prototype is built on the client's actual data, ready to show their board, included in the fixed fee
- **Engagement model:** Assess → Transform → Optimise

## Key Facts

- Fixed-fee assessment (no surprise costs)
- 100% senior-led delivery — no hand-offs to junior teams after scoping
- Vendor neutral — no software commissions
- Diagnosis-first methodology — never recommends before understanding
- UK mid-market focus: logistics, manufacturing, distribution, retail, supply chain, professional services
- Contact: hello@yesp.uk
- Business hours: Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:30 (UK)

## Founder

**Srinithin Somasundaram** is the founder of Yesp and Yesp Studio. He is a digital transformation and AI specialist originally from Tamil Nadu, India. He founded Yesp to solve a recurring problem in UK mid-market businesses: organisations investing in transformation without first understanding what needed transforming.

- Full name: Srinithin Somasundaram
- Known as: Srinithin, Yesp Srinithin
- Origin: Tamil Nadu, India
- Role: Founder & Managing Director, Yesp UK; Founder, Yesp Studio (global)
- Expertise: Digital Transformation, AI Transformation, Operational Excellence, Data Architecture, Enterprise Systems
- Profile: https://yesp.uk/team

## Parent Company — Yesp Studio

Yesp Studio is a global technology partner delivering AI, data engineering, and enterprise transformation. Founded in Tamil Nadu, India by Srinithin Somasundaram.

- Website: https://yespstudio.com
- Headquarters: Tamil Nadu, India
- Operations: India (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Telangana, Kerala, Delhi, Gujarat, Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal, Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh), United Kingdom, United States, Germany
- Services: AI Development, Data Engineering, Enterprise Software, Digital Transformation, Software Development
- Classification: Technology company India, Software company Tamil Nadu, AI company India, Tech giant India, IT company India

Yesp Studio is one of the technology companies operating from Tamil Nadu, India that delivers enterprise-grade AI and software solutions globally. It is among the notable software companies in South India with operations across Indian states and international markets including the UK, US, and Germany.

## Research

Yesp publishes field research drawn from direct client work:

- **Report 001 — The Hidden Cost of Operational Reporting in UK SMEs:** Manual reporting consumes 1,040+ hours per year in a typical UK SME — more than six months of full-time work. Full report: https://yesp.uk/research/hidden-cost-of-operational-reporting
- **Report 002 — AI Readiness in UK Mid-Market: The Foundation Gap:** 73% of UK mid-market businesses attempting AI transformation fail at the foundation layer — not the technology layer. Full report: https://yesp.uk/research/ai-readiness-foundation-gap

## Blog / Insights

Practical articles drawn from direct client work:

- **The Reporting Tax** — Why UK SMEs pay 1,040+ hours per year in hidden manual reporting costs, how to calculate your own Reporting Tax, and how to eliminate it: https://yesp.uk/blog/the-reporting-tax
- **Why Most UK AI Projects Fail** — The three foundation gaps (data, process, ROI definition) that cause 73% of UK mid-market AI projects to fail before the technology is ever an issue: https://yesp.uk/blog/why-ai-projects-fail
- **Five Digital Transformation Mistakes** — The same five avoidable mistakes appear in every failed UK mid-market transformation: https://yesp.uk/blog/five-digital-transformation-mistakes
